title: FY 2026 President's Budget - Commodity Futures Trading Commission
summary: The CFTC is requesting $410.0 million and 650 FTE for FY 2026, a 12.3 percent increase over FY 2025 enacted budget. The document provides divisional budget allocations (Enforcement, Market Oversight, Clearing and Risk, Data, etc.) and includes statistical appendices on the number of registered entities (SEFs, DCMs, DCOs, FCMs, SDRs) as of FY 2024. The document is a budget justification, not market structure research.
key_points: CFTC requests $410.0 million total for FY 2026, up 12.3% from FY 2025
Division of Market Oversight is one of several divisions with its own budget allocation
Document includes tables showing number of registered SEFs, DCMs, DCOs, FCMs, SDRs as of FY 2024
Budget request includes figures on volume of contracts traded and notional value of swaps
Customer Protection Fund referenced separately from operational budget
